[Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) › What the scheme provides]
Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year to eligible landholding farmer families,
paid in three equal instalments of Rs. 2,000 every four months. The money is
transferred directly into the beneficiary's bank account through Direct
Benefit Transfer (DBT).

[Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) › Who is eligible]
- All landholding farmer families that have cultivable land registered in
  their names, subject to the exclusion criteria below.
- A "family" for this scheme means husband, wife and minor children.
- State governments identify eligible families using land ownership records.

[Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) › Who is NOT eligible (exclusions)]
- Institutional landholders.
- Present or former holders of constitutional posts.
- Present or former ministers, MPs, MLAs, mayors and district panchayat chairpersons.
- Serving or retired officers and employees of central or state government
  departments and PSUs (excluding Multi-Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D employees).
- Anyone who paid income tax in the last assessment year.
- Practising professionals such as doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered
  accountants and architects.
- Pensioners drawing a monthly pension of Rs. 10,000 or more (excluding
  MTS / Class IV / Group D).

[Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) › Documents required]
- Aadhaar card (mandatory; eKYC must be completed)
- Land ownership records
- Bank account details or passbook

[Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) › How to apply]
Register through the PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in), a Common Service
Centre (CSC), or the state nodal officers. Completing eKYC (OTP-based or
biometric) is mandatory for instalments to be released.

[Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) › What the scheme provides]
Financial assistance to eligible rural households for the construction of a
pucca house with basic amenities. The unit assistance is Rs. 1.20 lakh in
plain areas and Rs. 1.30 lakh in hilly states, difficult areas and Integrated
Action Plan districts. Funds are released in instalments linked to stages of
house construction, directly to the beneficiary's bank account.

[Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) › Who is eligible]
- Houseless households, and households living in houses with kutcha walls
  and kutcha roofs, in rural areas.
- Beneficiaries are identified from housing deprivation data (SECC-based
  lists and the Awaas+ survey), verified by the Gram Sabha.
- Priority is given to the most deprived categories, including households
  with no adult member, no literate adult, and landless households deriving
  income from casual labour.

[Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) › Additional benefits (convergence)]
- Support for toilet construction through Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin).
- 90 to 95 person-days of unskilled wage employment under MGNREGA for
  house construction.
- LPG connection under Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana, and drinking water
  and electricity connections through convergence with related schemes.

[Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) › Documents required]
- Aadhaar number and consent document
- Bank account details (Aadhaar-seeded)
- MGNREGA job card number, where registered
- Swachh Bharat Mission beneficiary number, where available

[Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) › How to apply]
Beneficiaries do not apply directly; they are selected from the permanent
wait list generated from SECC / Awaas+ data and verified by the Gram Sabha.
Households can check their status through the local Gram Panchayat or the
PMAY-G portal (pmayg.nic.in).

[Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students (PMS-SC) › What the scheme provides]
Financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying at the post-
matriculation level (class 11 and above, up to post-graduation, including
professional and technical courses). The scholarship covers an academic
allowance (which includes maintenance) and compulsory non-refundable fees
charged by the institution.

[Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students (PMS-SC) › Who is eligible]
- The student belongs to a Scheduled Caste (a caste certificate is required).
- The student is studying in class 11 or above at a recognised institution.
- The combined annual income of the student's parents or guardians does not
  exceed Rs. 2.5 lakh.
- Only two male children of the same parents are eligible; there is no such
  restriction for female children.

[Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students (PMS-SC) › Documents required]
- Caste certificate issued by a competent authority
- Income certificate of parents/guardians
- Previous year's marksheet
- Aadhaar number and Aadhaar-seeded bank account
- Fee receipt and admission proof from the institution

[Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students (PMS-SC) › How to apply]
Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
or the relevant state scholarship portal within the notified application
window each academic year. The institution and the district welfare office
verify the application before the scholarship is sanctioned.

[Ayushman Bharat — Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)]
Ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (implemented by the National Health Authority)

[Ayushman Bharat — Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY) › Details]
The scheme "Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana", implemented
by the National Health Authority (NHA) under the Ministry of Health and
Family Welfare, Government of India, aims to provide cashless hospitalisation
coverage of ₹5,00,000 per family per year to poor and vulnerable families for
secondary and tertiary healthcare services. It was launched on 23rd September
2018 in Ranchi, Jharkhand.

"Ayushman Bharat" moves from a sectoral and segmented approach to health
service delivery towards a comprehensive need-based health care service,
covering prevention, promotion and ambulatory care at the primary, secondary
and tertiary levels. It adopts a continuum-of-care approach with two
interrelated components:

[Ayushman Bharat — Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY) › Details]
promotion and ambulatory care at the primary, secondary
and tertiary levels. It adopts a continuum-of-care approach with two
interrelated components:
1. **Health and Wellness Centres (HWCs):** comprehensive primary healthcare
   services, including maternal and child health, non-communicable disease
   care, free essential drugs and diagnostics, close to people's homes,
   promoting preventive healthcare.
2. **Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY):** cashless health insurance
   coverage of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary
   hospitalisation for poor and vulnerable families.

[Atal Pension Yojana (APY)]
Ministry: Ministry of Finance

[Atal Pension Yojana (APY) › Details]
Atal Pension Yojana (APY) is an old-age income security scheme for a savings
account holder in the age group of 18–40 years who is not an income-tax payee.
The scheme helps in addressing longevity risks among workers in the
unorganised sector and encourages workers to voluntarily save for their
retirement.

[Atal Pension Yojana (APY) › Focus of APY]
The scheme is mainly targeted at the poor, the under-privileged, and workers
in the unorganised sector.

[Atal Pension Yojana (APY) › Charges, fees and overdue interest]
Charges and fees and overdue interest for non-payment or delayed payment of
the prescribed contribution amount shall be levied on APY subscribers. These
charges and their method of application are prescribed by PFRDA from time to
time, in consultation with the Central Government.

[Atal Pension Yojana (APY) › Raising a grievance]
A subscriber can raise a grievance any time, free of cost, by visiting
www.npscra.nsdl.co.in (NPS-Lite) or through CGMS. The subscriber is allotted
a token number against the grievance and can check its status online.

[Kisan Credit Card (KCC)]
Ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

[Kisan Credit Card (KCC) › Details]
The KCC Scheme was introduced with the objective of providing adequate and
timely credit to farmers for their agricultural operations. The Government of
India provides an interest subvention of 2% and a Prompt Repayment Incentive
of 3% to farmers, making credit available at a very subsidised rate of 4% per
annum. The scheme was extended to the investment credit requirement of
farmers (allied and non-farm activities) in 2004, and revisited in 2012 to
simplify the scheme and facilitate issue of Electronic Kisan Credit Cards.
The scheme provides broad guidelines to banks for operationalising the KCC
scheme; implementing banks have discretion to adapt it to institution- and
location-specific requirements.

[Kisan Credit Card (KCC) › Objective / Purpose]
The Kisan Credit Card scheme aims at providing adequate and timely credit
support from the banking system under a single window, with flexible and
simplified procedures, to farmers for their cultivation and other needs:

- Short-term credit requirements for cultivation of crops
- Post-harvest expenses
- Produce marketing loan
- Consumption requirements of the farmer household
- Working capital for maintenance of farm assets and activities allied to agriculture
- Investment credit requirements for agriculture and allied activities

[Kisan Credit Card (KCC) › Type of Card]
- A magnetic stripe card with PIN and an ISO IIN to enable access to all bank
  ATMs and micro ATMs.
- Where banks want to use UIDAI's centralised biometric authentication
  (Aadhaar authentication), debit cards with magnetic stripe and PIN with ISO
  IIN plus UIDAI biometric authentication can be provided.
- Debit cards with magnetic stripe and only biometric authentication can also
  be provided depending on the bank's customer base.
- Banks may choose to issue EMV and RuPay compliant chip cards with magnetic
  stripe and PIN with ISO IIN.
- Biometric authentication and smart cards may follow common open standards
  prescribed by IDRBT and IBA, enabling seamless transactions with input
  dealers and crediting of sale proceeds at mandis and procurement centres.

[Kisan Credit Card (KCC) › Delivery Channels]
- Withdrawal through ATMs / micro ATMs
- Withdrawal through Business Correspondents using smart cards
- PoS machines through input dealers
- Mobile banking with IMPS capabilities / IVR
- Aadhaar-enabled cards

[National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)]
Ministry: Ministry of Education (Department of School Education & Literacy)

[National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS) › Details]
The "National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme" is a Central Sector Scheme
launched in 2008 by the Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry
of Education. The objective is to award scholarships to meritorious students
of economically weaker sections to arrest their drop-out at class VIII and
encourage them to continue education at the secondary stage.

Under the scheme, 1,00,000 scholarships are awarded to gifted or meritorious
students whose parental income is not more than ₹3,50,000/- per annum from
all sources at the time of selection. Each State/UT has a fixed quota of
scholarships. The scheme provides reservation to different categories of
students as per State/UT norms.

The scholarship is provided on a yearly basis to students studying as regular
students entering class IX in Government, Government-aided and local-body
schools, for a maximum period of four years (classes IX to XII). The scheme
has been approved for continuation during the 15th Finance Commission cycle
from 2021-22 to 2025-26.

[Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)]
Ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

[Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) › Details]
The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)" implemented by the
Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers' Welfare, Ministry of
Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, aims to supplement the financial needs of all
landholding farmers' families by procuring various inputs to ensure proper
crop health and appropriate yields, commensurate with the anticipated farm
income as well as for domestic needs. Under the scheme, an amount of ₹6,000/-
per year is released by the Central Government online directly into the bank
accounts of the eligible farmers under the Direct Benefit Transfer mode,
subject to certain exclusions.

[Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) › Benefits]
Financial Assistance: An amount of ₹6,000/- per year in 3 equal installments
of ₹2,000/- every four months is provided to each eligible family.

[Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) › Eligibility]
All landholding farmers' families, which have cultivable land holding in
their names are eligible to get benefit under the scheme.

[Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) › Exclusions]
The following categories of beneficiaries of higher economic status shall not
be eligible for benefit under the scheme:

[Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) › Exclusions]
following categories of beneficiaries of higher economic status shall not
be eligible for benefit under the scheme:
- All Institutional Land holders.
- Farmer families in which one or more of its members belong to the following categories:
  - Former and present holders of constitutional posts
  - Former and present Ministers/State Ministers and former/present Members of
    Lok Sabha/Rajya Sabha/State Legislative Assemblies/State Legislative
    Councils, former and present Mayors of Municipal Corporations, former and
    present Chairpersons of District Panchayats.
  - All serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government
    Ministries/Offices/Departments and its field units, Central or State PSEs
    and Attached offices/Autonomous Institutions under Government as well as
    regular employees of the Local Bodies (excluding Multi Tasking Staff/
    Class IV/Group D employees)

[Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) › Exclusions]
Institutions under Government as well as
    regular employees of the Local Bodies (excluding Multi Tasking Staff/
    Class IV/Group D employees)
- All superannuated/retired pensioners whose monthly pension is ₹10,000/- or
    more (excluding Multi Tasking Staff/Class IV/Group D employees of above category)
  - All persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year
  - Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and
    Architects registered with professional bodies and carrying out profession
    by undertaking practices.

[Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) › Application Process (Online)]
1. Visit the PM-KISAN Portal.
2. Click on "New Farmer Registration".
3. Enter your Aadhaar number and mobile number.
4. Enter the received OTP to authenticate your Aadhaar with UIDAI.
5. Fill in the required information and upload the mandatory documents.
6. Click on "Submit".

Application is also available via Common Service Centres (CSCs).

[Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) › Documents Required]
- Aadhaar Card
- Landholding papers
- Savings bank account

[Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)]
Ministry: Ministry of Rural Development

[Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) › Details]
Launched on 1st April 2016, Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana Gramin (PMAY-G) is the
centre's flagship mission by the Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD).
PMAY-G aims at providing a pucca house, with basic amenities, to all houseless
households and those households living in kutcha and dilapidated houses.
The minimum size of the houses under PMAY-G is 25 sq m including a dedicated
area for hygienic cooking. Beneficiaries are identified using the
Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC) parameters and verified by the Gram
Sabhas. The amount is transferred directly to the Aadhaar-linked bank
account / post office account of the beneficiary.

[Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) › Benefits]
- Financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 per unit for plain areas; and ₹1,30,000
  per unit for hilly areas, difficult areas, and IAP districts (Himalayan
  states, North-Eastern states, and UTs of Jammu & Kashmir).
- A willing beneficiary can avail institutional finance (loan) of up to
  ₹70,000 at a 3% lower interest rate; the maximum principal amount for which
  subsidy can be sought is ₹2,00,000.
- Minimum house size of 25 sq m including a dedicated area for hygienic cooking.
- In convergence with Swachh Bharat Mission-Gramin (SBM-G): financial
  assistance of up to ₹12,000 for construction of a toilet.
- In convergence with MGNREGA: entitlement to employment as unskilled labour
  at ₹90.95 per day for 95 days.
- In convergence with Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana: one LPG connection per house.
- Convergence with other programmes for piped drinking water, electricity
  connection, clean cooking fuel, and waste treatment.
- Payments are made electronically, directly to Aadhaar-linked bank or post
  office accounts.

[Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) › Eligibility]
The universe of eligible beneficiaries includes all houseless households and
households living in zero, one, or two-room houses with kutcha walls and
kutcha roofs (as per SECC data, subject to the exclusion process).

Criteria for automatic/compulsory inclusion:
1. Households without shelter
2. Destitute / living on alms
3. Manual scavengers
4. Primitive Tribal Groups
5. Legally released bonded labourers

[Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) › Eligibility]
Households without shelter
2. Destitute / living on alms
3. Manual scavengers
4. Primitive Tribal Groups
5. Legally released bonded labourers
Prioritisation within the universe: priority is first assigned on parameters
reflecting housing deprivation in each category (SC/ST, Minorities, Others).
Households are prioritised by houselessness, then by number of rooms (zero,
one, two, in that order). Deprivation scores are calculated from these
socio-economic parameters, each with equal weight:
1. Households with no adult member between ages 16 and 59
2. Female-headed households with no adult male member between 16 and 59
3. Households with no literate adult above 25 years
4. Households with any disabled member and no able-bodied adult member
5. Landless households deriving the major part of income from manual casual labour

5. Landless households deriving the major part of income from manual casual labour
Earmarking of targets: 60% of each State/UT's target is earmarked for SC/STs;
as far as possible 15% of the total fund is earmarked for Minorities at the
national level; States may ensure up to 3% of beneficiaries are persons with
disabilities.

Tie breakers (same deprivation score): households with widows and next-of-kin
of defence/paramilitary/police personnel killed in action; households where a
member suffers from leprosy or cancer, or is living with HIV; households with
a single girl child; beneficiary families under the Forest Rights Act, 2006;
transgender persons.

[Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) › Exclusions]
Step 1: Exclusion of pucca houses — all households living in houses with
pucca roofs and/or pucca walls, and households living in houses with more
than 2 rooms, are filtered out.

Step 2: Automatic exclusion — households fulfilling any one of these 13
parameters are automatically excluded:
1. Motorised two/three/four wheeler or fishing boat
2. Mechanised three/four-wheeler agricultural equipment
3. Kisan Credit Card with a credit limit of ₹50,000 or above
4. Household with any member as a government employee
5. Households with non-agricultural enterprises registered with the Government
6. Any member of the family earning more than ₹10,000 per month
7. Paying income tax
8. Paying professional tax
9. Owning a refrigerator
10. Owning a landline phone
11. Owning 2.5 acres or more of irrigated land with at least one irrigation equipment
12. 5 acres or more of irrigated land for two or more crop seasons
13. Owning at least 7.5 acres of land or more with at least one irrigation equipment

[Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) › Application Process (Online)]
The beneficiary registration process has four sections: personal details,
bank account details, convergence details, and details from the concerned
office. Steps: visit the official PMAY-G website; fill in personal details
(gender, mobile number, Aadhaar number, etc.); upload the consent form for
Aadhaar use; search for the beneficiary name, PMAY ID and priority; click
"Select to Register"; complete the remaining details (ownership type,
relation, etc.); add bank account details; if a loan is wanted, select "Yes"
and enter the amount; enter the MGNREGA job card number and SBM number. The
final section is completed by the concerned office.

[Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) › Documents Required]
- Aadhaar number and a self-attested copy of the Aadhaar card (for illiterate
  applicants, a consent letter with thumbprint)
- Job card (duly registered with MGNREGA)
- Bank account details (original and duplicate)
- Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM) number
- Affidavit stating the beneficiary or family members do not own a pucca house

[Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)]
Ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

[Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) › Details]
Launched on 18th February 2016, "Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana" is a crop
insurance scheme by the Department of Agriculture, Cooperation and Farmers'
Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture. PMFBY aims to provide financial protection
to farmers against crop loss due to natural disasters (hail, drought,
famine), pests, and diseases. PMFBY provides crop insurance at a
cost-effective premium to all Indian farmers, implemented through a network
of insurance companies and banks. The scheme covers over 50 crore farmers and
provides insurance coverage for over 50 different crops.

[Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) › Objectives]
- To provide financial assistance and support to farmers suffering from crop
  damage or loss arising out of unforeseen events.
- To stabilise the income of farmers and ensure continuance in farming.
- To encourage farmers to adopt modern and innovative agricultural practices.
- To ensure crop diversification and credit-worthiness of farmers, enhance
  growth and competitiveness of the agriculture sector, and protect farmers
  from production risks.

[Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)]
Ministry: Ministry of Finance

[Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) › Details]
Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) is an insurance scheme
offering life insurance cover for death due to any reason. It is a one-year
cover, renewable from year to year. The scheme is offered by banks/post
offices and administered through life insurance companies. All individuals
who are account holders of participating banks/post offices in the age group
of 18 to 50 years are entitled to join.

[Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)]
Ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development

[Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) › Details]
The Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) is a Centrally Sponsored
flagship scheme by the Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of
India, designed to support pregnant women and lactating mothers. The scheme
provides maternity benefits to women belonging to socially and economically
disadvantaged sections of society.

The maternity benefit is provided to a woman for the first two living
children, provided the second child is a girl.

[Post-Matric Scholarships for Scheduled Castes Students — Gujarat]
State: Gujarat (centrally sponsored — Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment)

[Post-Matric Scholarships for Scheduled Castes Students — Gujarat › Details]
The "Post-Matric Scholarships for Scheduled Castes Students" scheme was
launched by the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Ministry of
Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India. The scheme is implemented
by the Director, Scheduled Caste Welfare in the state of Gujarat. It is a
centrally sponsored scheme with a 60:40 sharing ratio between the Centre and
the States. The objective of the scheme is to appreciably increase the Gross
Enrolment Ratio of SC students in higher education, with a focus on those
from the poorest households, by providing financial assistance at the
post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their
education.

[Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)]
Ministry: Ministry of Finance

[Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) › Details]
An accident insurance scheme offering accidental death and disability cover
for death or disability on account of an accident.

[Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) › Premium]
₹20/- per annum per member. The premium is deducted from the account
holder's bank/post office account through the 'auto debit' facility on or
before 1st June of each annual coverage period under the scheme.

[Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) › Coverage duration]
Coverage is valid for one year, from 1st June to 31st May, on payment of the
annual premium.

[Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) › Termination / restriction of accident cover]
The accident cover of the member shall terminate or be restricted on any of
the following events:

- On attaining the age of 70 years (age nearer birthday).
- Closure of the account with the bank, or insufficiency of balance to keep
  the insurance in force.
- If a member is covered through more than one account and premium is
  received by the insurance company inadvertently, insurance cover will be
  restricted to ₹2 lakh.
